name: content-desk.board-read
purpose: Read the Content Desk marketing board once: current campaign/draft work, the deterministic next action per draft, capability readiness gaps, offer release readiness for active campaign scenarios, and the diff against a caller baseline.

baseline.description: Prior snapshot as {"campaigns": {id: status}, "drafts": {id: status}, "captured_at": rfc3339}. Omitted means no comparison is possible and changes_status reads no_baseline.

assumptions: Content Desk is the team's single declared address for campaign, draft and capability state.
The lifecycle status is the sole source of the next action; the program derives it and never invents work.
The caller retains the returned snapshot in its own continuity record and supplies it as the next run's baseline.
invariants: No writes: every declared binding has effect read.
A missing baseline is reported as no_baseline; it is never reported as an unchanged board.
A draft status outside the known lifecycle is reported as drift, never bucketed into a known next action.
readiness_limitations and the unknown qualification sentinel are copied verbatim from the owner response; they are never recomputed.
The campaign and draft reads are required; an unavailable capability read degrades the board to partial with an explicit error, never a failed board or a fabricated readiness count.

The offer release ladder is supplementary: an unavailable read degrades the board to partial with an explicit error, and a release-ladder entry whose readiness goal state the owner did not report is marked unknown, never false.
At most 80 rows per owner are materialized; a larger owner sets partial and says so.
The envelope is printed exactly once, on every path.

bindings.note: The capability catalog is supplementary readiness/next-action context; without it the campaign/draft board still reads and the envelope degrades to partial.

Called as release_ladder(rows='entries') for the offer release readiness of active campaign scenarios. Supplementary: without it the board degrades to partial with offer_readiness_unavailable, never a failed board or a fabricated goal state.

status.note: refused is unreachable: all bindings are read-only and run-eligible, so governance never withholds them.

signals.campaign_snapshot: Campaign id to status; the caller stores this as the next baseline.campaigns.
signals.active_campaigns: Bounded list of {id, name, scenario_names} for campaigns in the active status.
signals.unknown_campaign_status: Campaigns whose status is outside proposed/active/closed; drift, not a band.
signals.draft_status_counts: Count of drafts per lifecycle status.
signals.draft_snapshot: Draft id to status; the caller stores this as the next baseline.drafts.
signals.drafts_by_campaign: Count of drafts per campaign id, including an empty-id bucket.
signals.unknown_draft_status: Drafts whose status is outside the known lifecycle; drift, not a next action.
signals.current_work: Bounded list of {draft_id, campaign_id, channel, status, next_action} for drafts that are not terminal.
signals.next_actions: Bounded deduplicated next-action guidance derived from draft status.
signals.unknown_qualification: Capabilities whose latest qualification is absent (unknown sentinel).
signals.with_limitations: Capabilities carrying one or more readiness_limitations.
signals.capability_next_actions: Bounded deduplicated sample of capability next_action strings.
signals.changes: added, removed and status_changed per campaigns and drafts; null when no baseline was supplied.
signals.truncated: True when any owner exceeded the materialize cap.
signals.capability_read_status: read when the optional capability catalog answered, unavailable when it did not; the campaign/draft board always reads.
signals.offer_read_status: read when the optional offer release ladder answered, unavailable when it did not; the campaign/draft board always reads.
signals.offer_readiness: Offer release readiness for active campaign scenarios: ladder_entries read, the launch scenarios matched by name, and a bounded launch_targets list of {scenario, node_id, status, release_rank, readiness_goal_reported, readiness_goal_exists, readiness_goal_closed, readiness_approved_commit, blocked_by, next_action}. unknown_goal_state counts targets whose owner did not report a goal state.

outputs.evidence: The binding ids read for this run.

fixtures.note: Partial only when an owner exceeds the materialize cap; no baseline is reported, never treated as no change.
A malformed baseline is invalid_input, never partial.
